Who are you? Ello as I'm sure most of you all know, I am Dicy! I am a 24 year old recent college graduate currently job hunting (fucking kill me). I have been playing orgs for just over two years now after being a life long survivor fan. uh I'm sure you know the rest? nerd, likes pokemon, sports, frat boy, studied finance. Oh well I'm sure you will figure it out as we go, I just like to entertain a bit. Have my ORG Doc in case you care about play history (be warned I'm washed now): Dicy Org Tracker How did your first game of Snackvivor go? Do we really need to talk about this? Yes? Fine.... Season 2 of Snackvivor was a experience. Defined by one round of game play, one bad judgment call, a little bit too much showmanship, F10. I still believe my pre-merge of S2 is one of the best played in Snackvivor history, but it wont ever been seen as such thanks to good ole f10. The round that I'm known for in Snackvivor is also still to this day my biggest ORG regret. Besides the crash out, My snack game was socially strong but was a shit show of threat management which leads into me being targeted at F10 along with you know the whole lets send our selves to exile thing... How are you looking to approach this game with your first game in mind? I wasn't joking when I said it in spec chat, I am playing a hero's game moving forward. I've never tried to play that arc type of a game so I think it would be fun to try my best to play a morally good game for once, plus you know doing in my return to snack after how S2 went down feels fitting. The most important thing for me this season however, I want to just play. I have played the last few games with the idea of micro managing my threat level and I honestly think its just hurt me. I want to just play the game and have fun. sure I want to lean hero in gameplay but overall I want to trust myself to just play the game something I haven't done in a while. Rest to be answered after cast reveal :3

Since I'm cheating and doing this in the morning I likely wont be as organized and more just key point/free flowing this LOL To start I think the best play to start would be my current Trust rankings for the tribe before challenge one results: 1. Swiss (Duo: DICS) 2. Arvid 3. Toast 4. Becca 5. Ginny 6. Nasir I feel good on this tribe to start so far. I don't think I'm running the show or anything, but I do think I'm making the connections I need to within the game. Both Arvid and Swiss have hard claimed wanting to work with me in the game which is good since that's only 1 off of majority. I think I'm decently ranked with Toast/Ginny currently, but I'm not really sure were I sit with Becca. We haven't had the greatest of messages but I do like her vibe and get a good read so hopefully its like top of mid. As for game events to actually happen, me and swiss named and confirmed out Duo. DICS about to win duo of the season going start to end :3 BUTTTTTT swiss and I did game talk and I gave her pretty much everything I had at the time. gave my current vibe rankings, and the info that Arvid/Ginny are idol hunting already (which is nothing really LOL). She shared that she has had a similar read on the tribe as a whole and talked about the idea of having a split up allaince structure. a trio with Arvid, and a trio with Toast, which I'm all for I LOVE onion alliances when done right. Long term plans at the moment involve swiss but not so sure on Toast/Arvid. Swiss is like the prefect Duo for me in a game, she is fun and chaotic and will talk through Crazy game lines, but she is extremely smart in her play as well. On top of that she is a much more visible player then myself which gives me a little bit of a shield protection, no matter how even a split our duo us the game state will see the louder more visible player as the threat first. so for now I chill and behave and be friendly and slow burn social game these people. SOTD for 02/01/2025: Let's Get It Started

𝒟𝒾𝒸𝒾𝓃𝑒𝓂𝒶 3/7/2025 2:57 AM
To the Specs and Prod: I want to just want to give a massive thank you to everyone who payed attention to me this season, Love me or hate me I really hope I was able to give you some level of entertainment. This community means the fucking world to me and I love you all so so so much, I was truly blessed to be able to play in snackvivor again. Coming in I wanted to prove I was better then my mistakes of S2, I think I was able to do that. I truly am happy with the game I played, I know I played a great game this season. That being said I'm not fully over losing the game as of right now, but that's alright. I know with a little time I will be over it and be able to smile back on the game. I wasn't prefect this season by any means but I tried my best, I put my heart into this game fully. It failed short but it was still an experience I am glad I got to do once again. I cant wait to get back into the Prod side of snackvivor and get to work on bring you all the best games we can. To the Players: I love you all, you are all amazing people. I know some people didn't have a great time this season and im sorry for that. If I ever did anything that hurt you please reach out to me in DMs and we can talk about it, because it was all on a game level and nothing personal what so ever. Anything I ever said in a one on one or in my confessional here was all from a game standpoint and not a reflection of you as a person. I tend to get emotional and just say shit because of it so if I came off as rude about about you at any point I am truly sorry. You each helped make this season what it was and I thank you for that, everyone should be proud of what they did this season.
